title: Executive Revenue Review
context: The CEO wants a concise revenue readout before the Monday meeting. You must protect the analysis from dirty data, join the customer and order tables, calculate a KPI, select the right visual, and make a defensible recommendation.
cleaningPrompt: Before using the vendor customer export, which issues must be handled? Select all required actions.
cleaningOptions: Confirm and remove the exact duplicate O-1002 record with an audit trail.
Standardize North, north and NORTH to one category.
Parse mixed date formats into one validated date type.
Replace every missing customer name with Asha.
Delete all rows with any unusual value without investigation.
cleaningExpectedSelections: Confirm and remove the exact duplicate O-1002 record with an audit trail.
Standardize North, north and NORTH to one category.
Parse mixed date formats into one validated date type.
sqlPrompt: Using customers and orders, return segment and total_revenue for completed orders only. One row per segment.
kpiPrompt: Enterprise contributes 8000 of 13400 completed revenue. What percentage of completed revenue comes from Enterprise? Round to one decimal.
chartPrompt: Which chart best communicates completed revenue across the three customer segments?
chartOptions: Bar chart with segment on the axis and completed revenue as bar length
Pie chart with dozens of unrelated order IDs
Line chart with segment names treated as time
Scatter plot of row number versus customer name
chartExpected: Bar chart with segment on the axis and completed revenue as bar length
recommendationPrompt: Which executive recommendation is most defensible from this analysis?
recommendationOptions: Protect Enterprise revenue while investigating growth tests for Consumer and SMB; do not claim segment membership causes spending.
Stop serving Consumer customers immediately because Enterprise revenue is larger.
Tell the board Enterprise membership causes customers to spend more.
Ignore refunds and cancellations in all future reporting.
recommendationExpected: Protect Enterprise revenue while investigating growth tests for Consumer and SMB; do not claim segment membership causes spending.
